# Vendored bigint-buffer

This is a vendored copy of `bigint-buffer` 1.1.5's pure-JavaScript browser
build (`dist/browser.js`). The local package version is `1.1.6` so this
dependency satisfies the transitive `^1.1.5` range and dedupes to a single
copy in `package-lock.json`.

There is no upstream `1.1.6` release; the version number is local to this
repository. The vendored implementation is identical to the upstream browser
build and remains under the Apache-2.0 license.
